headline: Held work session on Burlington Forward resolution with no action taken
summary: The committee amended the agenda to remove two agenda items and focus on a work session about Burlington Forward. Members discussed several sections of the resolution, developed recommendations, and identified areas needing more information. The committee scheduled two more meetings for 9/8 and 9/9, but took no action.
plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Public Safety Committee 
Monday, August 31, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1st Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Buddy Singh (Chair), Melo Grant, Evan Litwin, Laura Sanchez-Parkinson 
  
Staff Present: Katherine Schad (Chief Administrative Officer) 
 
Public Present: Chris McGrath 
 
Meeting called to order at 5:36 PM by Councilor Singh. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
The agenda was amended to remove Items 3.1 and 3.2 to dedicate the meeting to a work session 
on Burlington Forward.  
 
Motion to adopt the agenda as amended.  
 
Motion by Councilor Grant, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.    Public Forum 
      2.01 Verbal Comments 
 
The first speaker commented on the loudness of emergency vehicles and that the crosswalk lights 
are too dim.  
 
Chris McGrath, a downtown resident, noted additional language added to Section 2.04 that 
references the Library’s public safety strategy and cautioned the Committee against copy and 
pasting their strategy to the parks because libraries are limited public forums, while parks are 
traditional public spaces and first amendment rights are the strongest.   
 
Public Forum closed at 5:43 PM.  
 
3.   Work Session: Burlington Forward  
     3.01  Situation Table Discussion w/ Anna Wageling CAIP BPD (Crisis Advocacy and 
Intervention Programs) 
 
Removed per amendment.   
 
   3.02  Urban Park Rangers Discussion w/ Deryk Roach Parks Division Director
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
 
Removed per amendment. 
 
   3.033.01  Continued Discussion on Burlington Forward 
 
The Committee worked through several sections of the resolution, developing recommendations 
and identifying where the Committee needs more information to make changes.  The Committee 
scheduled two upcoming meetings for 9/8 and 9/9.  No action taken. 
 
4.  Adjournment 
     4.01 Motion to Adjourn 
 
The meeting was adjourned with no objection at 7:38 PM.
